description: OTTASIA answers the question streaming search gets wrong outside the US: where can I legally watch this, HERE? Coverage spans 34 markets (India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Korea, Japan, the Gulf and more, plus the US, UK, Canada and Australia for the diaspora) and 60+ services, including regional platforms global tools miss (JioHotstar, ZEE5, Sun NXT, Aha, Hoichoi, Chorki, ARY Plus, Shahid, Viu, iQIYI). Availability comes from live data, including OTTASIA's own daily catalog scans of local services and free official-YouTube channels for Pakistani dramas. Also answers what's new on any service in any market, and finds titles across languages (English, romanized, or original script).
